name: Legacy Orochi
author: compsognathus3
description:
Here's the finalized version of the Extreme Demon Mitzuchi(now as Legacy Orochi). The Top 5-10/6-15 Extreme Demon(Demon Level) in the SGDC.
Note: This is no longer competition against Triangle of Time as I just wanted to finish this up for fun.
Legacy Orochi is an cancelled upcoming Fan-Remake Spin Off of the Upcoming Top 1 Extreme Demon Orochi.
However, in this version, it's the completed spin-off of Orochi. With it being rated 10 Stars and is a Extreme Demon.
